**Voica v0.9.0-rc.2 — the second candidate: six fixes from running rc.1 for real.**

Still a **candidate, not a release**, published as a pre-release: Voica's update check only looks at
the latest full release, so nobody is offered this automatically. About shows `0.9.0-rc.2`.

Everything rc.1 introduced is unchanged — working through a corporate proxy, the Network tab,
checksum verification of a hand-installed model, release candidates themselves. What follows are the
things that only showed up once somebody used it.

### A dictation nothing can transcribe is refused before it is spoken

With the cloud engine selected and no key set, Voica used to open the recording bar, record for as
long as you spoke, and only then say the key was missing. §2.5 already forbids exactly this for the
missing local model — "say it at the start, because telling someone after two minutes wastes the two
minutes" — and the reason is the person's time, not which engine happens to be selected. Now the
dictation does not start at all: a message names what is missing, offers Settings, and points out
that the local engine needs no key.

### The model download can be cancelled

A **Cancel** button appears in place of Download while the 215 MB is coming down. Switching
recognition back to the cloud stops it too, and a partial file is not left behind. Cancelling is a
choice, not an error, so nothing pops up to argue about it.

### Deleting the local model asks first

It is one click, and the way back is a 214 MB download — which on a metered or proxied connection is
exactly what cannot be repeated on a whim. The question says how much is freed and what stops
working until the model is back.

Your engine choice is left as you set it. If "Local (offline)" is selected without a model,
dictation refuses and says so, rather than quietly moving your voice to the cloud.

### Smaller things

- The Download/Cancel button no longer slides sideways when the status text next to it gets shorter.
- The explanation under **Language** moved into an ⓘ tooltip; the Dictation tab is 54 px shorter.
- After **Delete all data**, if a key is still coming from the `GROQ_API_KEY` environment variable,
  the app says so instead of leaving a filled key field under "all data deleted".

### Install

Windows 10 1809+ / x64:

| File | Size | Needs |
|---|---|---|
| **`Voica-Setup-0.9.0.exe`** | ~75 MB | nothing — recommended |
| `Voica.exe` | ~80 MB | nothing — single file, no installation |
| `Voica-fx.exe` | ~37 MB | [.NET 8 Desktop Runtime](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0) installed once |

The assets carry the base version `0.9.0`; the build reports `0.9.0-rc.2` in About. Installing over
an existing copy keeps your history, settings and API key.

Not code-signed yet, so SmartScreen may warn → **More info → Run anyway**
([why, and how to verify](https://github.com/Inhum/voica-win#why-does-windows-warn-about-this-app)).

Full changelog: https://github.com/Inhum/voica-win/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
